12' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Joan Garcia, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.

8' 1 - 0 Luis Milla sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) rises above the defenders to meet the ball and heads it straight into the right side of the goal. The score sheet now reads 1:0.
